title: Logarithmic bound for a polynomial expression
statement: For all nonnegative integers $A,c,B$, there is a nonnegative integer $K$ such that, for every nonnegative integer $n$, the base-two logarithm of $A(n+1)^c+B$, rounded down and then increased by one, is at most $K$ times the base-two logarithm of $n$, rounded down and then increased by one.
